integrity: The formula follows from an explicit proof and a reproducible finite-field check, without claims of exhaustive literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: Restricted-nilpotent commuting tuples only in the five-dimensional characteristic-five Witt algebra; the 2015 higher-tuple geometric paper full text was not accessible for historical priority exclusion. Finite checks do not establish arbitrary-arity claims, and independent validation has not been performed.
title: Finite-field commuting-nilpotent tuple census for the five-dimensional Witt algebra
